content: Hello, I am Meridian Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Sorry, Alex is away at the moment. Could you call back today at half past four?
I cannot call back today. When can Mx Rowan be reached on Thursday, October 15th, or Monday, October 19th, between 08:30 and 16:30?
I'm afraid I don't know Alex's plans for Thursday or Monday. Could you make it five o'clock today instead?
That time is not possible. Could Mx Rowan be reached on Thursday, October 15th, or Monday, October 19th, between 08:30 and 16:30?
Sorry, I really can't say when Alex will be free on those days, so I don't want to promise a time. You'd be best trying again another day.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
